subject: Micro credit sponsorship while PO in flight — ClearBridge pilot
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Soto <alex@clearbridgehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Micro credit sponsorship while PO in flight — ClearBridge pilot

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for running the pilot with Redwood — your team’s prompt feedback on the summarization models was really helpful. I heard from our onboarding tracker that procurement has the PO routed but sign-off is slower than expected. Totally understandable.

To avoid the Proof-of-Concept stalling while the PO is in flight, we can offer a one-time micro sponsorship to keep your sandbox and eval environments live for an extra 7 days. High level:
- Amount: $150 USD credit (covers ~5k tokens at expected usage)
- Duration: 7 days from activation
- No change to the contract or billing terms — this is a temporary, one-off goodwill credit to preserve momentum

If that works for you we’ll request quick internal sign-off and apply the credit immediately once you confirm. Attached is a 1‑page pilot summary (pilot-summary.pdf) in case procurement needs a short justification.

If you prefer a different amount/duration, tell me what you need and we’ll try to accommodate.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142

---
Attachment: pilot-summary.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

From: Alex Soto <alex@clearbridgehealth.com>

Cc: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@clearbridgehealth.com>, procurement@clearbridgehealth.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Micro credit sponsorship while PO in flight — ClearBridge pilot

Marissa — thanks for the note and for the proactive offer. We definitely want to keep the pilot running; the models looked promising in yesterday’s demo.

Quick heads up about procurement: our legal and finance teams are reluctant to accept "credits" unless they’re documented on an internal requisition or covered by an approved vendor statement. PO is in flight (approver queue) but I can’t promise timing.

Two asks from our side:
1) Can you share a short one-paragraph justification we can attach to the PO?
2) If we accept the temporary credit, can Redwood invoice or produce a short confirmation that this is a one-time courtesy and won’t alter the commercial terms?

Looping in Lisa from procurement — Lisa, do you see an avenue to accept a one-off credit tied to a vendor note, or should we wait for the PO?

— Alex
Product Lead, ClearBridge Health
alex@clearbridgehealth.com

Thanks Alex — appreciate the context and looping Lisa in.

Lisa — short justification you can attach to the PO or vendor note: 

"Redwood Inference has agreed to a one-time, temporary credit of $150 USD to keep ClearBridge Health's pilot environment active for 7 days while the purchase order completes internal approval. This credit is a goodwill sponsorship to preserve pilot continuity, will be recorded by Redwood as a one-off promotional credit, and does not change the commercial terms, pricing, or future invoicing tied to the forthcoming PO (Deal CB-2027-447)."

We’ll also provide a short confirmation letter (one-line) on Redwood letterhead stating the same. I’m attaching a text file with the proposed terms for quick copy/paste: micro-credit-terms.txt.

If this format is acceptable, we’ll route for internal approval on our end; I anticipate a same-day sign-off from my manager for this amount.

Marissa

Hi Alex — quick technial note from the onboarding side:

If you want the demo to reflect production-like performance while we keep the sandbox live, I recommend:
- Keep sequence length at 1024 for summarization pipelines (saves tokens)
- Enable short-term KV cache for the session to lower latency and token counts
- If you expect heavy reruns, we can temporarily bump batch size to 8 on the dedicated demo instance (Camila can coordinate).

Estimated burn: ~4k–6k tokens/day depending on user testing cadence. The $150 estimate should cover ~5k tokens under normal usage; if you think you’ll exceed that, tell us and we can adjust.

Camila Reyes
